acceptanceCriteria: CLI --lsp gopls|off explicitly selects bounded semantic enrichment while legacy and off bytes remain compatible.
Opt-in MCP profile and per-call selector share pinned evidence with CLI; existing profiles never launch LSP and reject the new selector.
Live gopls CLI/MCP qualification records exact versions, meaningful definition/reference witnesses, parity, dirty-file omission and process cleanup; unobserved broad agent benefit stays explicit.
Consumer documentation, focused checks, independent review, CEM/OCM evidence and draft PR are retained; ticket remains open pending required landing/completion.
body:
Implemented and merged Go LSP integration in https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/356 at cf93522e149c754e002426e422270f24c88777fe (reviewed head d335d34ea8ae1bf5a776cf15cf80f8d4f01a282b). CLI --lsp gopls|off and opt-in task-review-lsp MCP profile share pinned semantic evidence; defaults, ranking and project authority remain unchanged.

Independent source and prelanding reviews found no remaining actionable issues. Focused tests, vet, documentation checks, compiled gopls qualification, canonical evidence checks and both seals passed. Hosted CI https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/actions/runs/36589023262 passed all jobs, including four race-test shards, product aggregate, documentation, interoperability and artifact checks; required ci-control-plane status also passed. CI's stale task-orientation receipt was corrected and independently checked without changing product source.

Source bind aea3b83d8d3e6d4f688a5b421029c2ae08274e98; repair bind 854b8999fd42dc3f9993532331fca6ca536d4d87. Durable local evidence: /Users/russelllewis/projects/corvint/.git/corvint/task-evidence/V1-0476/manifest.json, SHA-256 2695e977814d0b0a4b157f980fd5220d48236dd7453bc678d9fdb169960fa2e3. User explicitly approved landing and completion. Manual completion is used because the installed Tasks runtime does not implement submit/gate run/complete; no failed gate is bypassed.

Limits retained: experimental Go only, no broad retrieval/productivity promotion, V1-0168 remains separate, OCM/frontier uncertainty remains explicit, repair prechange ledgers STALE. Native audit authentication/liveness/runtime qualification remain NOT_OBSERVED and semantic coverage UNKNOWN.
